message.content:
Looking at this question, I need to identify where SLC14A1 serves as a specific marker for endothelial cells.

SLC14A1 encodes the sodium-coupled neutral amino acid transporter 2 (SNAT2). In single-cell RNA sequencing studies of the liver, SLC14A1 has been identified as a specific marker for liver sinusoidal endothelial cells (LSECs), which are the distinctive endothelial cells lining the hepatic sinusoids.

This is consistent with the known expression pattern of SLC14A1 in hepatocytes and liver vasculature, and its identification as a distinguishing marker for the endothelial cell population in liver single-cell atlases.

[ANSWER]C[/ANSWER]
